title: 'A tricky day' ahead for French PM as he meets with unions amid social unrest
summary: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is to meet unions and employer federation representatives on Monday to discuss salaries and purchasing power following a wave of social unrest across France in recent weeks.
